name: Bastet
body:
Just as a cat protects a home from disease-carrying vermin, Bast—the Vigilant Mistress—is called upon to protect the household and its inhabitants from disease and evil spirits.

Mistress

Bast appears as a sensuous, dark-skinned, human female with a feline head, dressed in diaphanous clothing. She carries a percussion instrument called a sistrum in one hand and wears either a breastplate or an elaborate necklace engraved with the head of a lion.

Pleasure-seekers and common folk turn to Bast to bless them and keep them safe from danger.

Cats

Granted Powers: You have the coordination and resilience of a feline. Like your goddess, you can be fickle, seducing your enemies one moment and filling them with fear the next.

Feline Nature (Sp)

You can use your feline nature ability in one of two ways; you can seduce a creature with a purr or frighten it with a hiss. As a swift action, you can purr, granting yourself a bonus (untyped) equal to 1/2 your cleric level (round up) on the next Diplomacy check you make within the round. Alternatively, as a standard action, you can hiss at a target within 10 feet. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, roll a d6. On a roll of 1 or 2, the creature gains the frightened condition. On a roll of 3 or 4, the creature gains the panicked condition. On a roll of 5 or 6, the creature gains the cowering condition. These conditions last for 1 round. On a successful save, the creature is shaken for 1 round instead. This is a fear effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Feline Hybrid Form (Ex)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can assume a hybrid form for 1 minute, during which time you gain one primary natural bite attack that deals 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage (1d4 for Small or 1d8 for Large creatures) and two natural secondary claw attacks that deal 1d6 + 1/2 Strength modifier slashing damage (1d4 for Small or 1d8 for Large creatures). You make attacks with these natural weapons using the BAB of a fighter equal to your cleric level and can apply either your Strength or your Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher) on attack rolls. Furthermore, while in this form, you gain several bonuses; the DC to jump is not doubled if you don’t have a running start, the DC on all jump checks is decreased by 4, you automatically land on your feet for all falls of 100 feet or less, and you are treated as though you have the Multiattack feat, so your secondary claw attacks only take a -2 penalty to hit. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-jump, 2nd-cat’s grace, 3rdburst of speed, 4th-darkvision, greater, 5thbaleful polymorph, 6th-cat’s grace, mass, 7thunerring tracker, 8th-nine lives, 9th-animal shapes.

Special: This domain is available to druids through their Nature Bond class feature.
